selection_objective: No learned parameter selection. Validate fixed conventional estimators, document performance failures; no universal structure classification.
seed_policy: NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence([seed_root,family_index,trial_index]); one independent latent experiment per row; shared within-row frames are nested
sealed_policy: Generate/open only after implementation hashes and calibration decision are committed and pushed. If changed after exposure, retire bank. Maximum three explicit diagnosed rounds; no repeat-until-pass.

winding.noise: bounded additive complex noise of modulus at most 0.025; scale is supplied as measurement uncertainty, not learned from outcome
winding.sampling_contract: Known smooth generator curve, no intersample phase change >= pi; branch-ambiguous and missing-edge families must abstain. No assertion for unknown arbitrary physical fields.
winding.acceptance: Correct winding and non-abstention for admissible loops; correct abstention for deliberately invalid support. Report these separately; no always-abstain credit.
winding.baseline: independent atan2 phase-unwrapping calculation; endpoint-link product and amplitude-only ablations
winding.false_positive_scope: nonzero winding on the registered smooth zero-winding family only; random phase may have nonzero sampled winding and is not automatically a physical null

temporal.coherence_threshold_formula: 1-alpha**(1/(K-1)) for K independent complex Gaussian Fourier pairs under independence
temporal.null: independent stationary Gaussian signals; colored case identical fixed FIR applied separately to each independent segment
temporal.surrogate: 63 independent phase offsets per segment on one channel, preserving within-segment amplitude/spectrum and destroying inter-channel phase consistency
temporal.window: production declared nonoverlap window, checked in freeze
temporal.claim_scope: registered interior frequency, independent segment generator model; no omnibus physical-null or causal inference
temporal.baseline: conventional magnitude-squared coherence; phase-removal ablation; no TLD credit

metrology.geometry: Cartesian rectilinear, explicit SI units, unequal spacing
metrology.analytic_truth: solid rotation curl 2a, constant and shear divergence/curl from exact linear coefficients
metrology.mask: interior hole removes every touched stencil; no zero fill as observation
metrology.baseline: legacy index-space gradient; exact physical analytic derivative
metrology.claim_scope: numerical construct verification, not noisy physical error rate

prospective_gate: All relevant construct, uncertainty, coverage and independent verification gates plus domain compatibility must pass. This benchmark alone does not authorize a general physical field classification.
